about_us_body:
Welcome to Daxu, a place where learning becomes collaborative.

Our mission is simple: to create an open and powerful platform where students, teachers, and curious minds from all over the world can create, share, and master any subject through smart study tools like flashcards and mind maps.

Daxu was born from the idea that no one learns alone. We believe that knowledge blossoms when it is shared. Whether you are a student preparing for a big exam, a teacher looking for new ways to engage your class, or someone simply passionate about learning, Daxu is made for you.

We are committed to building a positive and supportive learning community. Join us and let's learn together!

terms_of_use_body:
Last updated: October 09, 2025

Welcome to Daxu. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to comply with these Terms of Use.

1. Use of the Platform
You agree to use Daxu only for lawful and educational purposes. You are responsible for all content you post, including flashcards, comments, and other materials.

2. User Content
By posting content on Daxu, you retain ownership of your content. However, you grant us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, and display that content for the sole purpose of operating and promoting the platform.

3. Prohibited Conduct
You are strictly prohibited from posting content that:
Is illegal, harmful, threatening, abusive, or hateful.
Infringes on any copyright, trademark, or other intellectual property rights of others.
Is spam, unsolicited advertising, or chain letters.
Contains software viruses or any other computer code designed to interrupt or destroy the functionality of any software or hardware.

4. Moderation and Termination
We reserve the right to remove any content or suspend/terminate user accounts that violate these terms, at our sole discretion and without notice.

5. Disclaimer of Warranties
Daxu is provided "as is." We do not guarantee that the platform will always be available, secure, or error-free. Content provided by users does not necessarily reflect the views of Daxu.

6. Changes to Terms
We may modify these terms at any time. We will notify you of changes by posting the new terms on the site.
privacy_policy_body:
Last updated: October 09, 2025

Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how Daxu collects, uses, and protects your information.

1. Information We Collect
Information You Provide: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, and password when you create an account.
Usage Information: We collect information about how you use the platform, such as the pages you visit and the features you use.
Cookies: We use cookies and similar technologies to operate and improve our service, as well as to personalize your experience.

2. How We Use Information
To provide, maintain, and improve our services.
To communicate with you, including sending service-related emails.
To personalize the content and advertisements displayed to you.

3. Third-Party Advertising and Cookies
Our website displays ads from third-party vendors, including Google.
These vendors use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to our website or other websites.
Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to our users based on their visit to our sites and/or other sites on the Internet.
You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google's Ads Settings.

4. Information Sharing
We do not share your personal information with third parties except as described in this policy or with your consent.

5. Security
We implement security measures to protect your information, but no system is 100% secure.

6. Contact Us
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at daxu@daxu.app.
